name: csm-kit
description: Evidence-cited Customer Success brief engine: turns CSV exports + a small YAML account file into markdown briefs where every fact cites its source span.

scripts.example: node bin/csmkit.js brief --account examples/acme/account.yaml --crm examples/acme/crm.csv --tickets examples/acme/tickets.csv --usage examples/acme/usage.csv --as-of 2026-08-22 --stats --out examples/example-renewal-brief.md && node bin/csmkit.js brief --type handoff --handoff examples/acme/handoff.yaml --crm examples/acme/crm.csv --questions examples/acme/questions.csv --as-of 2026-08-22 --out examples/example-handoff-brief.md && node bin/csmkit.js brief --type qbr --account examples/acme/account.yaml --crm examples/acme/crm.csv --tickets examples/acme/tickets.csv --usage examples/acme/usage.csv --as-of 2026-08-22 --out examples/example-qbr-packet.md
